1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.IntrinsicSurfaceMetric
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SurfacePathCompactness
3 
4 /-! Normalized intrinsic geodesics form a compact family, even while both
5 endpoints vary. The topology is uniform convergence of actual surface curves. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
8 
9 open Set Filter BoundedContinuousFunction
10 open scoped Topology NNReal
11 
12 /-- Curves with values on the actual boundary, with the uniform metric. -/
13 abbrev BoundaryCurve (P : ConvexPolyhedron) := unitInterval →ᵇ (frontier P.body)
14 
15 /-- Intrinsic distances on the compact boundary have one finite common bound. -/
16 theorem surfaceDist_uniform_bound (P : ConvexPolyhedron) :
17     ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ x y : frontier P.body, P.surfaceDist x y ≤ C := by
18   letI : CompactSpace (frontier P.body) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp
19     (P.body_compact.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_frontier P.body_closed.frontier_subset)
20   have bounded : BddAbove (range (fun pair : (frontier P.body) × (frontier P.body) => P.surfaceDist pair.1 pair.2)) :=
21     (isCompact_range P.surfaceDist_continuous).bddAbove
22   obtain ⟨C, bound⟩ := bounded
23   refine ⟨⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _⟩, ?_⟩
24   intro x y
25   exact (bound ⟨(x, y), rfl⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
26 
27 /-- The intrinsic constant-speed geodesic equation, with no prescribed endpoints. -/
28 def geodesicCurves (P : ConvexPolyhedron) : Set P.BoundaryCurve :=
29   {f | ∀ s t, P.surfaceDist (f s) (f t) = P.surfaceDist (f 0) (f 1) * dist s t}
30 
31 /-- The geodesic equation survives uniform limits, since intrinsic distance is continuous. -/
32 theorem geodesicCurves_closed (P : ConvexPolyhedron) : IsClosed P.geodesicCurves := by
33   have evaluation (t : unitInterval) : Continuous (fun f : P.BoundaryCurve => f t) := continuous_eval_const t
34   have distance (s t : unitInterval) : Continuous (fun f : P.BoundaryCurve => P.surfaceDist (f s) (f t)) :=
35     P.surfaceDist_continuous.comp ((evaluation s).prodMk (evaluation t))
36   unfold geodesicCurves
37   simp only [setOf_forall]
38   exact isClosed_iInter (fun s => isClosed_iInter (fun t =>
39     isClosed_eq (distance s t) ((distance 0 1).mul continuous_const)))
40 
41 /-- Surface curves sharing an ambient speed bound form a compact family. -/
42 theorem boundary_curves_with_speed_compact (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (C : ℝ≥0) :
43     IsCompact {f : P.BoundaryCurve | LipschitzWith C f} := by
44   letI : CompactSpace (frontier P.body) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp
45     (P.body_compact.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_frontier P.body_closed.frontier_subset)
46   have closed : IsClosed {f : P.BoundaryCurve | LipschitzWith C f} :=
47     (isClosed_setOf_lipschitzWith C).preimage continuous_coeFun
48   apply BoundedContinuousFunction.arzela_ascoli₂ univ isCompact_univ _ closed (fun _ _ _ => mem_univ _)
49   apply Metric.equicontinuous_of_continuity_modulus (fun r : ℝ => C * r)
50     (by simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds.mul (tendsto_id : Tendsto (id : ℝ → ℝ) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0))))
51   intro x y f
52   exact f.property.dist_le_mul x y
53 
54 /-- All normalized geodesics form a compact family, uniformly over all endpoint pairs. -/
55 theorem geodesicCurves_compact (P : ConvexPolyhedron) : IsCompact P.geodesicCurves := by
56   obtain ⟨C, bound⟩ := P.surfaceDist_uniform_bound
57   apply (P.boundary_curves_with_speed_compact C).of_isClosed_subset P.geodesicCurves_closed
58   intro f geodesic
59   apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
60   intro s t
61   have lower := P.dist_le_surfaceDist (f s).property (f t).property
62   rw [geodesic s t] at lower
63   exact lower.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (bound (f 0) (f 1)) dist_nonneg)
64 
65 namespace SurfacePath
66 
67 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a b : Space}
68 
69 /-- Regard a surface path as a curve in the boundary's ordinary subspace topology. -/
70 noncomputable def boundaryCurve (path : P.SurfacePath a b) : P.BoundaryCurve :=
71   mkOfCompact ⟨fun t => ⟨path.curve t, path.on_surface t⟩, path.curve.continuous.subtype_mk _⟩
72 
73 /-- Every normalized shortest surface route satisfies the compact family's geodesic equation. -/
74 theorem boundaryCurve_geodesic (path : P.SurfacePath a b) (shortest : path.IsShortest)
75     (finite : path.length ≠ ⊤) (speed : LipschitzWith path.length.toNNReal path.curve) :
76     path.boundaryCurve ∈ P.geodesicCurves := by
77   intro s t
78   change P.surfaceDist (path.curve s) (path.curve t) =
79     P.surfaceDist (path.curve 0) (path.curve 1) * dist s t
80   rw [path.surfaceDist_along shortest finite speed, path.curve.source, path.curve.target,
81     surfaceDist, ← path.length_eq_surfaceEDist shortest]
82 
83 end SurfacePath
84 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
